title_zh: 明确管线施工通行安排的联系人

scenario.label_zh: 明确管线施工通行安排的联系人
scenario.goal_zh: 询问水管施工期间的通行影响，并约定由协调员核实二十六号门口通行方案后提供图示及联络号码

context_zh: 居民向虚构城市供水工程的现场协调员询问步行通道安排。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: The notice says the water pipeline will be replaced along this street. Who can explain how we’ll reach our front doors?

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: I oversee communication with residents. The crew plans to work in short sections to minimize disruption, but I need to check the arrangement for your entrance.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: It’s number twenty-six. My mother uses a walking frame, so a general notice won’t tell us enough.

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: I’ll ask the site supervisor about that doorway and bring you the marked access plan before work reaches this block.

sentences.speaker: Paul
sentences.text: Could you also put your contact number on it in case the arrangement changes?

sentences.speaker: Rina
sentences.text: Yes. I’ll be your contact for updates, and I’ll include the number on the plan.
